null_model: Independent uniform residual-edge selection within exact squared-grid-distance strata, conditional on scanner-specific stratum counts.
null_distribution: Exact convolution of hypergeometric overlap distributions over distance strata.
exact_tail_probability_interpretation: Conditional combinatorial null probability, not population-level biological significance.
limitations: Distance-stratified null does not preserve feature correlations
Distance bins do not fully capture spatial edge topology
Spatial and global graphs have different candidate pools
Some dense configurations may have little null variance
The regions belong to one acquisition pair
No clinical downstream task has been evaluated
